summary: Describes a transparent cell transport service using the N-to-one cell relay mode for ATM pseudowires. It carries ATM cells over a packet network without interpreting them.

eli5.summary: ATM sends data in tiny fixed boxes called cells. This note describes carrying those cells across a modern packet network like a sealed pipe, with no peeking inside.

questions: what is atm transparent cell transport
how are atm cells carried over a packet network
subtitle: Carry every ATM cell on a port across a packet network as if it were a plain leased line.

tldr.problem: Operators want to move ATM services onto a packet switched network (PSN) without reconfiguring the customer edge (CE) ATM devices.
tldr.mechanism: The ingress provider edge (PE) drops idle or unassigned cells and maps all other cells from an ATM port to a single pseudowire, using the N-to-one cell transport mode. The egress PE sends them out unchanged.
tldr.outcome: The CEs see the service as if they were connected by a TDM leased line. The security of the carried ATM service is only as good as the PSN underneath.

today: RFC 4816 is a Proposed Standard. It has not been obsoleted or updated according to the metadata for this RFC.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
This RFC describes a transparent cell transport service. It lets an operator migrate ATM services to a packet switched network (PSN) without having to provision the ATM subscriber or customer edge (CE) devices. The CEs see the service as if they were directly connected through a Time Division Multiplexer (TDM) leased line.

The RFC says the service is most likely to be used inside an ATM service provider's network, either to connect existing ATM switches over a higher-speed PSN or to provide ATM backhaul for remote access to existing ATM networks.
sections.eli5: An old kind of network wants to ride on a newer one. This note says how to do it so the old equipment never notices the change.

sections.title: Transparent Port Service
sections.content:
The service is a natural application of the N-to-one Virtual Circuit Connection (VCC) cell transport mode from RFC 4717. It MUST be used with pseudowires of type 0x0003, "ATM transparent cell transport". It emulates connectivity between two remote ATM ports, which is useful when two CEs should be connected without any processing or switching at the Virtual Path Connection (VPC) or VCC layer.

The ingress PE discards any idle or unassigned cells from the ingress ATM port and maps all other cells to a single pseudowire. The egress PE does not change the VPI, VCI, PTI or CLP bits when it sends the cells out of its ATM port. Because idle and unassigned cells are dropped, the service benefits from statistical multiplexing bandwidth savings.
sections.eli5: The sender throws away empty boxes and puts all the real ones into one tube. The receiver hands them out exactly as they came in.

sections.title: Concatenation, OAM and Failures
sections.content:
Cell concatenation MAY be used to save PSN bandwidth. If used, it MUST be agreed between the ingress and egress PEs. When the pseudowire was set up with the PWE3 control protocol (RFC 4447), the ingress PE MUST NOT exceed the "Maximum Number of concatenated ATM cells" value it received in the Label Mapping message, and MUST NOT use concatenation if the egress PE omitted that parameter.

ATM Operations and Management (OAM) cells and ILMI signaling from the CEs MUST be carried transparently, and the PEs do not act on them. If the PEs detect a PSN or pseudowire failure, they do not generate OAM cells. They bring down the ATM interfaces to the CEs, for example by generating LOS on the ATM port, just as for a transmission layer failure. On a physical interface failure the PEs must withdraw the PW labels or use pseudowire status signaling.
sections.eli5: Special repair notes pass straight through the tube. If the tube breaks, the ends switch off their lights so each house knows the cable is down.

sections.title: Security and Congestion
sections.content:
The RFC introduces no new security considerations beyond those in RFC 4717 and RFC 4447. It warns that the security of the transported ATM service is only as good as the security of the PSN, which might be less rigorous than a native ATM service.

Congestion control considerations are identical to those in section 15 of RFC 4717. The RFC adds that the PWE3 Working Group was doing more work on ATM-related congestion and that implementers should expect an RFC with additional techniques.
sections.eli5: The tube is only as safe as the road it runs along. Traffic jams are handled the same way as for the older rules this note builds on.
